fields.assessment_notes: Shadow Realm Collectibles now reads as a real nearby Bell Gardens TCG store with a useful but cautious Commander signal. Wizards/EventLink already supports Monday Commander night, and official Linktree routing plus review/organized-play mirrors support active operation and broader TCG event-hosting. The personal-fit caution is that the Commander listing has paid-entry and prize-pool language, so it may be more tournament/prize-oriented than the user's ideal relaxed casual lane. Treat it as a plausible nearby option to watch, not a top casual recommendation until social posts or community evidence clarify turnout, power level, proxy norms, and solo-arrival behavior.

operations.reason: Promote Shadow Realm from discovery placeholder to reviewed first-pass assessment with explicit cautions and TBDs.

fields.assessment_notes: Buddies Collectibles now reads as the richest source-routing candidate in this nearby thin-store batch. Wizards/EventLink supports Friday casual Commander, while the official site and weekly tournament page show active TCG commerce and tournament infrastructure. The official Linktree routes to Discord, Instagram, Twitch, Whatnot, YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, and the shop; that makes Buddies worth a later bounded Discord survey. The caution is that public official and review surfaces are heavily commerce/live-break oriented, and review mirrors preserve pricing, live-break model, and busy-store service concerns. Treat Buddies as a watch/try candidate if Commander-specific Discord or social evidence looks good, not as an automatically warm casual home-base.

operations.reason: Promote Buddies from discovery placeholder to reviewed first-pass assessment with source-routing and review cautions.

fields.assessment_notes: TK Collectibles now reads as a real Newport Beach TCG shop with an existing Saturday Casual Commander listing, but the public source texture remains stronger for Pokemon/collectibles and general retail quality than for Magic community depth. Official site, review mirrors, and non-MTG organized-play locators support active physical operation, friendly staff, clean/kid-friendly local-shop signals, and event-hosting capability. The Commander listing should stay visible, but TK is not yet a priority Magic-community target until Instagram or another store-controlled source confirms current MTG promotion, turnout, or casual-social texture.

operations.reason: Promote TK from discovery placeholder to reviewed first-pass assessment while preserving weak MTG-community depth.

fields.assessment_notes: Aki Collectibles is a real San Gabriel TCG shop with an existing Saturday Commander record, but the current source mix supports broader TCG retail activity more strongly than Magic community depth. Existing evidence already includes Instagram, Google/search, TCGplayer seller reliability, and Wizards/EventLink; added review mirrors support a clean shop, friendly staff, strong Pokemon/One Piece/sealed/singles activity, and active commerce. Keep Aki visible as a confirmed Commander option, but treat it as a lower-priority personal target until store-controlled posts or community evidence show meaningful Commander turnout, draft/prerelease activity, or solo-friendly MTG texture.
